messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PD P1 triggered — 75% CrashLoopBackOff on namespace=prod, deployment=inference-canary. Alert group: k8s.deploy.crashloop. Link: https://pd.redd.wn/INC195123

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started by ci/cd pipeline (release/v2.14.3) 6m ago. Current status: 3/12 pods Ready, 9 CrashLoopBackOff. Rolling update automatically paused by controller. See deploy job: https://ci.redd.wn/2045

cassie (oncall): I'm on it. Paging eng-runtime and eng-sre. @raj @mike can you grab logs and kube events? tagging incident channel. :wave:

raj: looking now — attaching kube describe on a failing pod:

```
Name:         inference-canary-7f4d6c9b8-ptx2
Namespace:    prod
Status:       CrashLoopBackOff
Reason:       BackOff
Last State:   Terminated
  Reason:     Error
  Exit Code:  1
  Started:    Tue Mar 15 14:02:10 UTC 2026
  Finished:   Tue Mar 15 14:02:11 UTC 2026
Events:
  Type    Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----    ------     ---   ----               -------
  Normal  Scheduled  6m    default-scheduler  Successfully assigned prod/inference-canary-... to node-23
  Warning Unhealthy  5m    kubelet            Liveness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 404
```

raj: container logs show startup crash after attempting to fetch model artifact:

```
2026-03-15T14:02:10.123Z ERROR model_loader Failed to open weights file: file not found: /models/inference/v2.14/model.bin
2026-03-15T14:02:10.124Z INFO  sidecar Attempting fallback to cached path /cache/models/v2.14
2026-03-15T14:02:10.125Z ERROR runtime Unrecoverable: model artifact missing, exiting
```

mike: interesting — the chart update for v2.14.3 changed the `modelPath` default to `/models/inference/v2.14` and also updated liveness probe path from `/healthz` to `/live` in the Helm diff. I think the image expects the artifact at a different mount. I'll grep the helm values commit.

olivia: quick customer impact: metric check — 500s spiking for inference route in eu-west-1 and p90 latency doubling. Preliminary estimate ~12 tenants affected (canary subset). Marking customer impact P1.

cassie (oncall): thanks. Two-pronged mitigation: 1) stop the rollout / pause and revert if quick; 2) toggle feature flag to prevent traffic to canary. Trying non-destructive first.

sre-bot: HPA snapshot: deployment/inference currently scaled to 12 -> recent chart change accidentally set `minReplicas: 0` in values. HPA has scaled to 0 briefly during rollout steps and some nodes evicted pods. Patch suggested: `kubectl patch hpa inference -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'`.

cassie (oncall): do not scale to 0. Applying patch now then pausing rollout and toggling feature flag.

```
# run by cassie
kubectl patch hpa inference -n prod -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'
kubectl rollout pause deployment/inference -n prod
redwood feature toggle inference_canary --off --env=prod
```

deploy-bot: Feature flag toggle acknowledged by FF service. Traffic router update: redirecting canary traffic to stable for the route `inference.generate` (eu-west-1).

raj: after patch + pause, new pods start but still CrashLooping — liveness probe path mismatch (404) and model mount missing. We need to either rollback the chart or patch the deployment to mount the old model path.

mike: I can push a quick emergency patch to helm values to restore `modelPath: /models/inference/v2.13` and liveness `/healthz` then `kubectl rollout restart`. Prefer rollback if available. Anyone can run `kubectl rollout undo`?

olivia: rollback preferred — less risk. cassie, can you revert to previous revision in the namespace and confirm image tag?

cassie (oncall): running rollback to revision 122 (last-known-good) now:

```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference -n prod --to-revision=122
```

sre-bot: Rollback started. Controller is bringing back old replica set. New status: 10/12 pods starting with image=registry/release:v2.13. Waiting for readiness.

raj: after rollback, pods come up healthy. liveness probe returning 200 at `/healthz`. No model missing errors in logs.

olivia: customer metrics — errors dropping back to baseline within 2m of rollback. p95 latency back within 10%. Marking mitigated for live traffic. Notifying ops and account teams.

mike: root cause looks like a bad values commit in the release branch that updated both modelPath + liveness path and inadvertently set HPA minReplicas to 0. Need CI guard to catch config drift and a pre-rollout integration test to validate mounts and probes.

cassie (oncall): we'll keep the rollback as the immediate fix. Assigning follow-ups: ENG-RUNTIME (config validation + tests), ENG-RELEASES (pipeline guard), SRE (HPA deployment safeguard).

olivia: summarizing customer impact: 12 tenants in eu-west-1 saw 5xx spikes for ~6 minutes, estimated 2% of global requests touched. No data loss, only availability blips. Sending incident notice to accounts.

cassie (oncall): handing off to olivia for long running postmortem and follow-up action items. I'm going offline in 10m but will be reachable for questions. Handoff note: rollback applied, feature flag off, HPA minReplicas patched to 2, rollout paused.

olivia: taking over — will open a postmortem ticket and coordinate changelog + release block until fixes land. Adding impact + timeline to the ticket. Thanks for the quick ops.

sre-bot: Incident P1-195123 resolved (mitigated). Auto-closing PD alerts in 1h unless escalated.

mike: quick note for postmortem — add the following diff snippet from the bad commit:

```
- modelPath: /models/inference/v2.13
- livenessPath: /healthz
- hpa:
-   minReplicas: 2
+ modelPath: /models/inference/v2.14
+ livenessPath: /live
+ hpa:
+   minReplicas: 0
```

olivia: copying that into the postmortem. I'll also ask product to freeze canary releases for the day. Follow-ups: add mount validation in CI, gate HPA minReplicas change for manual review, and add canary health checks in the pipeline.

cassie (oncall): thanks team. closing comms here — please update the incident ticket with any extra logs. :white_check_mark:

olivia: will do. moving to incidents/postmortems next.
